title: [학사] 영어졸업인증 대체특강 안내 (2027-2월 졸업대상자)

analysis.target: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자(학사학위 수료자 포함). 단, 신청종료일까지 자격기준에 미달되는 공인영어성적표(토익(스피킹), New TEPS, OPIC 등) 제출기록 필수(제출할 곳: 학과사무실); 제출기록이 없는 학생 신청불가
summary: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자(학사학위 수료자 포함) 대상 영어졸업인증 대체특강 수강생 모집
강의기간: 2026.12.28(월) ~ 2027.01.08(금) 17:00 (10일간, 온라인 비실시간 녹화 강의 및 실시간 퀴즈, 수강료 무료)
신청 전제조건: 신청종료일까지 학과사무실에 기준 미달 공인영어성적표를 제출한 기록이 필수적으로 있어야 신청 가능
신청방법: 인하포털시스템 로그인 → 학적 → 학적인터넷신청 → [신청종류] 졸업인증토익특강 → 희망반(오전/오후) 선택 후 저장
analysis.easyExplanation: 2027년 2월에 졸업 심사를 받는 학생(학사학위 수료자 포함) 중 공인영어성적으로 졸업인증을 대체하려는 학생을 위한 무료 온라인 특강입니다. 신청 전까지 학과사무실에 기준 미달 공인영어 성적표를 반드시 제출해 둔 기록이 있어야 하며, 2026년 12월 21일 09:00부터 12월 22일 16:00까지 포털을 통해 신청할 수 있습니다.

en.title: [Academic Affairs] Notice on Substitute Special Lecture for English Graduation Certification (for February 2027 Graduation Candidates)
summary: Recruitment for the Substitute Special Lecture for English Graduation Certification for students subject to February 2027 graduation evaluation (including students who completed coursework [학사학위 수료자])
Lecture period: December 28, 2026 (Mon) – January 8, 2027 (Fri) 17:00 (10 days, online asynchronous recorded lectures and real-time quizzes, tuition free)

Prerequisite: Must have a submission record of an official English test score report below the certification criteria to their department office before the end of the application period; those without a record cannot apply

How to apply: Log in to Inha Portal System → Academic Affairs (학적) → Academic Internet Application (학적인터넷신청) → [Application Type] TOEIC Special Lecture for Graduation Certification (졸업인증토익특강) → Select preferred class (Morning/Afternoon) → Save
en.easyExplanation: This is a free online special lecture for students undergoing graduation evaluation in February 2027 (including students who completed coursework [학사학위 수료자]) to fulfill the English graduation certification requirement. You must have already submitted an official English test score report that does not meet the standard to your department office before applying, and you can apply via the portal from 09:00 on Dec 21, 2026 to 16:00 on Dec 22, 2026.
en.target: Candidates for February 2027 graduation evaluation (including students who completed coursework [학사학위 수료자]). However, a submission record of an official English test score report (TOEIC (Speaking), New TEPS, OPIc, etc.) that does not meet the qualification criteria to the department office by the application deadline is mandatory; students without a submission record are not eligible to apply.
en.eventInfo: Substitute Special Lecture for English Graduation Certification held online asynchronously with recorded videos and live quizzes
